notes:
2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/56). Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json, collector_number 56): "Tiered (Choose one additional cost.)
• Blizzard — {0} — Return target creature to its owner's hand.
• Blizzara — {2} — Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
• Blizzaga — {5}{U} — Target creature's owner shuffles it into their library." Mana cost {1}{U}, type line 'Instant' — both verified against fin_scryfall.json, unchanged from definition.ts.

Scenario count: kept the 3 existing mode-gated scenarios (Blizzard/Blizzara/Blizzaga), one per real Tiered tier, per the corrected standing rule (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md, 2026-09-12, Restoration Magic/fin-30): 'Tiered' counts as real branching for SCENARIO-count purposes, same as an explicit 'Choose one —' modal, even though the 3 tiers are mechanically unrelated targeted zone-moves here (unlike Restoration Magic's own one-escalating-idea shape) — an even stronger case for 3 scenarios than Restoration Magic's own borderline one. scenarios.ts required no changes; it already had exactly this 3-scenario shape from before this migration.

Fact model: NOT exploded to 3 duplicate per-tier facts — checked Restoration Magic's own actual synergy.json/annotations-authoring.json as the named precedent first (not just its prose) and found it explicitly keeps facts COMPACTED by real distinctness (2 fact-pairs covering 3 tiers: one shared by Cure+Cura, one Curaga-only) with its own progress.json stating outright 'this data-modeling call isn't reopened' by the scenario-count correction. Ice Magic's own 3 tiers resolve to only 2 REAL distinct zone movements given this model's vocabulary: Blizzard alone is Battlefield→Hand (bounce); Blizzara and Blizzaga are BOTH Battlefield→Library — top-vs-bottom placement (Blizzara) and the shuffle (Blizzaga) are both real mechanical details this model doesn't track (per definition.ts's own longstanding comments, unchanged), so they are honestly indistinguishable in the fact vocabulary today. Authoring 2 byte-for-byte-identical fact objects (differing only in which tier's oracle line they anchor to) would be pure duplication with zero informational or matching value, the same 'don't explode when nothing actually differs' judgment Restoration Magic's own migration already made — not a partial application of the task's literal wording, but the same real precedent it named, checked directly rather than assumed. Flagged explicitly since the task text described RM as 'per-tier fact-splitting,' which the actual RM files contradict.

Final facts (4 source, 1 sink), all -1 value sentinel (none run through compute-weights.mjs yet), all real annotations baked via compute-annotations.mjs off a new annotations-authoring.json: self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'} and self-graveyard {to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'} (both typeLine-anchored on 'Instant' — no presence-shaped source, an Instant has no entersBattlefield/dies for itself, same pattern as fate-of-the-sun-cryst/restoration-magic). bounce: {from:'Battlefield', to:'Hand', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} — Blizzard's own real 'Return target creature to its owner's hand,' anchored on its own line; deliberately NO controller (real Forge ValidTgts$ Creature has no owner restriction — any player's creature, confirmed against definition.ts's own pre-existing comment). to-library: {from:'Battlefield', to:'Library', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} — covers BOTH Blizzara and Blizzaga's real zone change (top/bottom-of-library and shuffle-into-library both land the creature in the Library zone; neither position/shuffle detail is tracked), anchored on Blizzara's own line (the first, chronologically earliest tier using this to/from pair, same 'anchor on the first shared occurrence' convention Restoration Magic's own grant-hexproof-targeted fact uses for its own Cure+Cura-shared fact). No `controller` on this fact either, same no-owner-restriction reasoning. `target` on both movement facts is informational only, same as Phoenix Down's own reanimate fact — confirmed by re-reading factsInteract's own zone-matching branch: it never reads a SOURCE zone fact's `target` field, only `subject` (for the reverse case) and the WANT side's own constraints — not a new matching capability, just honest self-describing data. New (from, to) pair used for the first time in the pool: Battlefield→Library — checked ZONE_MOVEMENT_NAMES for an existing name and found none (no established one-word MTG term the way bounce/tutor/reanimate have); left UNNAMED rather than inventing one, since `describeFact`'s own structural fallback already renders an honest generic label ('moves to Library (from Battlefield)') for any unnamed pair — same 'grow named vocabulary only when a real, common term exists' discipline Phoenix Down's own reanimate/tutor additions already followed.

Real bug fixed during migration, sink: the old (pre-migration) sink was {zone:'Battlefield', controller:'opp', types:{has:['Creature']}} — wrongly restricted to the OPPONENT's creatures only. Real oracle text and definition.ts's own longstanding comment both confirm no owner/controller restriction on any of the 3 tiers' targeting (any creature, either player's). Fixed to {to:'Battlefield', types:{has:['Creature']}}, no controller — matches fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own unconstrained-target sink precedent exactly.

Added 'ice-magic' to scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs's ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS. verify-synergy.mjs: scoped OK (0 hard failures); full pool 316 v2 cards checked, 4 pre-existing hard failures unrelated to this change (cecil-dark-knight-cecil-redeemed-paladin, ice-flan, stiltzkin-moogle-merchant, white-auracite — all from concurrent in-flight sessions per git status, ice-magic itself OK). vitest run functional-model: 238/238. find-synergies.mjs real before/after diff (isolated via git stash of just ice-magic/synergy.json against the current, otherwise-dirty working tree, so only this card's own change is isolated): the 13 real graveyard-presence + 1 real library-presence matches relabel from 'graveyard presence'/'library presence' to 'moves to graveyard'/'moves to library (from battlefield)' (expected zone→to rename plus the new unnamed-pair fallback phrasing, zero count change, zero real loss — first pass at this diff misread the label-text change as a loss before normalizing labels and re-checking by card-pair only). Real gains: +4 outgoing (Ice Magic's own bounce/library facts now reach Haste Magic, Nibelheim Aflame, Resentful Revelation, The Water Crystal — all real Hand/Library-presence wants with controller:'you' or unconstrained, previously blocked by the old fact's incorrect controller:'opp'); +108 incoming (the sink's controller:'opp'→unconstrained bug fix now matches every real creature-producing card regardless of which player would end up controlling the created/entering creature, not just opponent-side producers) — both real, accounted-for, correctness-over-match-count fixes, not silent regressions.

Open Forge-verification: none needed — real oracle text confirmed directly against data/fin/fin_scryfall.json (collector_number 56, mana_cost {1}{U}, matches definition.ts exactly); this pass is a fact-model/vocabulary migration onto already-correct, previously-authored engine mechanics (definition.ts/scenarios.ts unchanged), not new engine work.
knownGaps: Blizzara's real 'top or bottom of their library, owner's choice' and Blizzaga's real 'shuffles it into their library' are both represented as the identical Battlefield→Library zone fact — this model has no library-position/shuffle tracking (same pre-existing gap definition.ts's own comments already documented before this migration), so the two tiers are honestly indistinguishable in the fact/matching vocabulary today, not just in scenario replay.

No real trace evidence distinguishes Blizzara from Blizzaga (both scenarios call the same underlying move('Library') action) — verify-synergy.mjs's own reverse-evidence check for the shared to-library fact is satisfied by either scenario alone; same pre-existing softness class Restoration Magic's own progress.json already flags for its own Cure/Cura-shared targeted fact.
